project.name: web-game-forge
project.summary: Buildless engine for HTML game prototypes on native ES modules; one HTML file per prototype wired to engine/ via import maps.
stack: JavaScript (native ES modules, no build step)

nextSteps: Adopt OpenSpec flow: every non-trivial change starts as openspec/work/SPEC-*.json
Keep examples/_smoke.html green after engine changes

longTermFacts.fact: There is no build step: prototypes load the engine through an import map with the 'my-engine' alias pointing at engine/index.js.
CDN versions are pinned: pixi.js 8.6.6, three 0.170.0, gsap 3.12.5, json5 2.2.3 (jsdelivr). Do not float versions.
Configs are JSON5 and support $extend for inheritance. deepMerge (engine/utils/deep-merge.js) replaces arrays instead of merging them.
PixiJS v8 specifics: Application.init() is async; sprite-sheet animations live on texture.animations (not texture.baseTexture); destroy(true, { children: true }) is wrapped in try/catch.
Static HTTP server is mandatory; file:// fails because ES modules and import maps require CORS. Use scripts/dev.sh or python3 -m http.server.
scripts/verify.sh starts python3 http.server on a free port and asserts HTTP 200 for every examples/*.html and prototypes/*/index.html.
The Vite/React app in src/, index.html and the React dependency list in package.json are Freebuff sandbox scaffolding and are not part of the engine. Engine work must not modify them.
engine/index.js is the single public surface: createGame() plus re-exports of every subsystem factory; new public APIs must be re-exported and documented in README.md.
OpenCode v1 читает opencode.json в корне, AGENTS.md и .opencode/agents|plugins; .opencode/config.json игнорируется, ключей hooks/sdd в схеме нет.

decisions.title: Adopt a dependency-free local SDD environment under .opencode/
decisions.context: The project is deliberately buildless and minimal; adding MCP servers, embedding services or a vector database would contradict its constraints.
decisions.decision: Use plain Node.js for the TF-IDF index and memory CLI, OpenSpec JSON documents as the agent-to-agent language, and bash+curl for asset fetching.
decisions.consequences: Zero new dependencies; the index is a rebuildable JSON artifact and is gitignored. Agents must use .opencode/vector-index/reindex.sh after structural edits.

decisions.title: Конфигурация переведена на схему OpenCode v1
decisions.context: Установлена v1: .opencode/config.json не читается, hooks и произвольные ключи схемой не поддерживаются.
decisions.decision: opencode.json в корне (agent/permission/instructions/mcp), субагенты — .opencode/agents/*.md с YAML-frontmatter, промты в .opencode/prompts/, автоиндексация — плагин .opencode/plugins/sdd-reindex.js.
decisions.consequences: Права агентов теперь задаются frontmatter, а не отдельным конфигом; память закрывается явной командой, так как в v1 нет события конца сессии.
